name: MCP Add Server
description: Mirrors an external MCP server into the catalog (#80): lists ALL the server's tools and materialises each as an ordinary operation. Scope 'user' (default) puts them in your o/mcp/<name>/ namespace; scope 'venue' (requires the mcp/manage ability) puts them at v/ops/mcp/<name>/ for everyone. To curate individual tools at paths of your choosing (including cross-server groups), use v/ops/mcp/add-tool instead. The server URL passes the same SSRF validation as the http adapter. Auth should be a secret reference (s/<name>, stored via v/ops/secret/set) — resolved at call time, never persisted raw.

name.description: Registry name for the server — becomes the catalog path segment; must match [a-z0-9-]{1,64}

url.description: MCP server URL (http/https). A URL with no path implies /mcp; an explicit path is used as-is; a trailing slash expresses an exact root endpoint

auth.description: Optional bearer credential: a secret reference 's/<name>' (recommended), a DID-qualified reference 'did:.../s/<name>', or a literal token (discouraged — the registry persists on the lattice)

scope.description: Where the bridged ops materialise. Default 'user' (your o/mcp/ namespace); 'venue' (v/ops/mcp/, shared) requires the mcp/manage ability

tools.description: Names of the bridged tool operations
